strategy: The robot will navigate toward the goal by prioritizing forward movement when clear, then left, then right, while avoiding obstacles and stopping safely when necessary.
decisions: MOVE FORWARD if the goal is ahead and FORWARD is clear
MOVE LEFT if the goal is to the left and LEFT is clear
MOVE RIGHT if the goal is to the right and RIGHT is clear
STOP if all directions are blocked or a safe stop is required
stop_condition: STOP if all movement directions are blocked or a safe stop is required
